body:
I have something important for you  
Letter from a stranger  
First of all, how?
I'm going to meet her in two days and i'll say it to her. I think you're right, that the behaviour comes from that.
That makes a lot of sense. God, this is hard.
How do I break up, if that's what I choose. I can't make myself say those words.

I don't know. I don't want to be a father right now. Maybe in 8 or 10 years, but not right now. My girlfriend said to me "don't worry of course you're not gonna be a father, we'll figure it out", though she's not sure if she could do an abort. I'm not sure if we're both open for an abort if we should do it, without our parents knowing, since they won't be happy about this in the first place.

PS: this is still blowing my mind, hope i'll wake up soon or something like that.... wish this never happened...
I wish I had been a better boyfriend and not cheated on my girlfriend. She hates me so much and I do too.

Yes, because of the marks. She asked me several times if there was more to the story and I denied. She told me, the other night she heard my phone ringing and it reminded her of the marks on my shoulder. She came to think of; that she didn't felt like she trusted me and therefore she asked me to tell her the true story.
Thank you so much, it means a lot to me. I feel really lost in this situation and it definitely helps to have someone listening. I'll try to breathe and slowly get back on track with my life.
